policy: Background literature must be formally published: no arXiv-only or other preprint-only records are used where a published version exists. Entries without a Crossref DOI are admitted when they are either peer-reviewed proceedings not indexed by Crossref or first-party model/dataset artifacts used as experimental inputs and pinned by immutable revision URL. BibTeX is supplied explicitly for every such entry.
